finalModelMessage:
I registered for “Building Accessible Forms in Java” as Jordan Lee, first submitted the malformed email `jordan-not-an-email`, then corrected it to `jordan.lee@example.com` and accepted the terms.

What stopped me: I could not complete registration because the meal preference control is not exposed in the accessibility tree. The snapshot only shows the text “Meal preference…” with no combobox, listbox, or labeled select, so `selectOption`/`click`/`type` all fail. Submitting without a meal preference also does not proceed or report a confirmation code. No confirmation code was given.
